title: QUIC RFC 9000 MAX_STREAM_DATA Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P10 requirement-home tests, Release build, full Release no-build solution tests, QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry run, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers MAX_STREAM_DATA parser and formatter behavior, field order, Stream ID and Maximum Stream Data variable-length integer handling, affected-stream credit application, send-limit enforcement, sparse receive accounting, and remembered stream-limit violations for RFC 9000 Section 19.10 requirements 0001 through 0014.
expected_result: Focused S19P10 requirement homes prove that MAX_STREAM_DATA frames use type 0x11, preserve Stream ID and Maximum Stream Data varint fields, reject malformed/truncated encodings, apply the field as an absolute byte offset for the affected send-capable stream, reject invalid stream targets, enforce advertised stream-credit limits, allow sparse receive offsets caused by reordering, and reject remembered-limit violations with FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR.
procedure: Run the focused S19P10 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release no-build solution test suite.
Run the QuicFrameCodec benchmark suite with BenchmarkDotNet Dry job.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing QuicFrameCodec MAX_STREAM_DATA parser and formatter are the runtime seam under test.
The existing QuicConnectionStreamState flow-control bookkeeping remains the state seam under test.
Public server-side 0-RTT receive admission remains closed; remembered-limit proof is limited to stream-state limit enforcement.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim public 0-RTT receive admission, server anti-replay support, public receive-window API changes, or endpoint-host close-packet behavior beyond the parser and stream-state seams.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S19P10 filter passed 41/41, regenerated triage reports 14/14 S19P10 requirements as trace_clean, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 391 artifacts, the full Release no-build solution suite passed 4180/4180 after the retry-token diagnostic race helper was hardened, and the QuicFrameCodec BenchmarkDotNet Dry run completed 14/14 benchmarks including ParseMaxStreamDataFrame at 758.8 us and FormatMaxStreamDataFrame at 285.7 us with no allocations.
